body: If you dare to take up the banner of Enlightenment you will be attacked from all sides. From the inside you will be attacked by your own mind and from the outside you will be attacked by everyone else's mind. Anyone who dares to succeed automatically presents ahuge threat. If true Freedom is going to survive within you, you have to be willing to fight for it. You have to have a sword in each hand at all limes. One sword is for your own mind and the other sword is for everyone else's mind. You must be ready to use them. Anyone who wants to be truly Free must be willing to stand alone in the Truth. 2 5 2
